title: REQ · Hovering a scene object emits a typed objectHover event to React
summary: Pointer hover and out on a scene object emit objectHover with the id or null
description: Context: SceneObject wires handle.onHover only to highlight and label; PhaserToReactEvents.objectHover exists but nothing emits it. Desired behavior: BootScene forwards hover to the phaserToReact bus. Expected result: React listeners learn which object is hovered. Why: the UI can mirror hover state.
acceptance_criteria: Given a visible SceneObject, when its handle hover callback fires with true, then onHover listener receives objectId and over true and the highlight and label are shown
Given a hovered object, when hover fires with false, then BootScene emits objectHover with id null
Given a hidden object, when hover fires, then no listener call and no highlight occurs

preserve: Existing hover highlight and label behavior

technical_constraints: Event payload shape is { id: string | null }
definition_of_done: objectHover emitted on hover in and out
